user.title: Connect to TimeTree
user.description: Sign in with your TimeTree account. The credentials are only used to talk to the official TimeTree API.

calendars.title: Select calendars
calendars.description: Choose every TimeTree calendar that should appear in Home Assistant. Each one becomes its own calendar entity and device.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: TimeTree no longer accepts the stored password of {email}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TimeTree API
error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant log

abort.already_configured: This TimeTree account is already configured

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.description: Add or remove TimeTree calendars. Entities of removed calendars are deleted.

sync.title: Polling and events
sync.description: How often TimeTree is polled and which details are shown for every event.

data.description_details: Add labels and attendees to the description

export.title: Export to another calendar
export.description: TimeTree stays the source of truth. Exported copies carry an invisible marker so they can be matched later. Choose a Google calendar entity as target to keep Google in sync.

data.export_delete_removed: Delete exported copies of removed TimeTree events
data.import_unmanaged: Import events that only exist in the target

conflicts.title: Conflict handling
conflicts.description: A conflict is raised when the TimeTree event and its exported copy both changed since the last run.

data.notify_conflicts: Create a notification for new conflicts

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TimeTree API, the stored calendars are shown

options.two_way: Two way (target changes are written back)

refresh_now.name: Refresh now
refresh_now.description: Poll TimeTree immediately instead of waiting for the next scan.

list_conflicts.name: List conflicts
list_conflicts.description: Return every change that waits for a manual decision.

resolve_conflict.name: Resolve conflict
resolve_conflict.description: Decide what should happen with one conflicting event.

conflict_id.name: Conflict id
conflict_id.description: The id reported by the sync conflict sensor.

action.name: Action
action.description: Which side wins, or whether the conflict should be skipped.

resolve_all_conflicts.name: Resolve all conflicts
resolve_all_conflicts.description: Apply the same decision to every pending conflict.

get_event.name: Get event
get_event.description: Return the raw TimeTree details of one event.
